models.name: OpenAI Privacy Filter
models._model_revision_note: Pin to a specific hub revision before recording any measurement. Unset means the hub resolves whatever is current, which makes results unreproducible (VM1.2).
models._confidence_threshold_note: Default 0.0 = report every span the classifier emits, i.e. maximum recall. For a privacy filter that is the SAFE default: a missed entity leaks, a spurious one only costs utility. Raising it trades recall for precision and therefore increases leakage, so any non-zero production value needs justifying against a measured recall floor (AD1.2). A per-request 'threshold' overrides this so an operating point can be swept without changing the default (AD1.4).
